item.title: [New] Workforce Insights endpoint in MODS retires 18 November; custom non-public attributes such as job level move to the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint and become visible to Copilot experiences
item.description:
Non-public HR attributes such as job level that were scoped to one Frontier agent become available to Copilot experiences generally once they move to the profile endpoint, which is a data-exposure decision for privacy and governance, not a plumbing change.

Copilot · If you upload custom attributes to the Workforce Insights endpoint, list them, agree an access policy with privacy stakeholders, then re-select the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint before 18 November.

item.title: [New] Copilot Cowork gains Power Platform connectors governed only from the Microsoft 365 admin center; Power Platform DLP policies do not apply to Cowork
item.description:
A tenant that relies on Power Platform DLP to keep business data away from third-party connectors has no such control over Cowork: the only gate is the admin-center connector list, and every connector Microsoft adds there becomes usable in Cowork as it arrives.

Copilot · Before mid-November review Agents > Tools in the Microsoft 365 admin center, block the Power Platform connectors your DLP policies forbid, and record that Power Platform DLP does not cover Cowork.

item.description:

item.title: [Message Center] MC1542062 Copilot Cowork: Power Platform connectors now follow Microsoft 365 admin center settings
item.description:
Microsoft Copilot Cowork now supports Power Platform connectors managed via the Microsoft 365 admin center, allowing centralized control over connector use with third-party apps. Rollout completes by mid-November 2026. Admins should review and configure connector availability, noting that Power Platform DLP policies do not apply to Cowork.
